### Fixed

- (agent-platform) [Show a missing release file as information under the skills table](https://github.com/giantswarm/backstage/pull/3158) by [@marians](https://github.com/marians) — When `Update all skills to latest` cannot open a pull request because the agent is defined elsewhere in GitOps, the dialog says `Skills cannot be updated here` under the skills table instead of an orange warning, explains where to change the pins and offers only `Close`.
